# Gross (BB144) stage 4, cells G-4R and G-4F: results of the one analysis (generated by `python -m bb.stage4_gross analyze`)

150,000 test4 shots. Each comparison: exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.016667 and the paired Newcombe (1 - alpha) interval of LER(hybrid) - LER(opponent) entirely below 0; a cell's claim needs all its comparisons and its speed condition.
